findings.summary: The mkdocs source page has a near-duplicate description of the collector's 'What it inspects' behavior (matching arr/README.md before this change) but wasn't updated with the same one-finding-per-download dedup note, so the published docs and the README now describe the guarantee inconsistently. CLAUDE.md's 'Docs sync — never skip' section lists this exact file as one to update after any meaningful change.
